meta: Ride-hailing and delivery drivers get the most out of AI before they start driving, over their morning coffee.

muc.title: Use AI before you drive
muc.text: Ride-hailing drivers get the most out of AI before they start, while still having their morning coffee.

muc.title: Plan your day
muc.text: Tell AI your hours, busy areas and income goal, and ask for sensible shifts with breaks.

muc.title: Polite reply templates
muc.text: Ask AI for ready-made replies: on my way, sorry about the traffic, please come out to the gate.

muc.title: No phone while driving
muc.text: Never type or read messages while driving. Pull over safely before using your phone.

muc.title: Five customer replies
muc.text: Tonight, ask a chatbot for five replies to common customer situations, then save them as quick replies.
